entities.name: PMID:25079429
observations: Du et al. 2014 studied allelic variation in the PtoSAHH family and wood properties in Populus tomentosa.
Open-access full text is available as PMC4118623; DOI 10.1186/1471-2156-15-S1-S4.

entities.name: PtoSAHHA
observations: One of two S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine hydrolase family members isolated from Populus tomentosa xylem.
Noncoding SNP PtoSAHHA_2203 and its haplotype significantly associated with alpha-cellulose content in discovery and validation populations (Q < 0.10).

entities.name: PtoSAHHB
observations: One of two S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine hydrolase family members isolated from Populus tomentosa xylem.
Noncoding SNP PtoSAHHB_1065 associated with alpha-cellulose content; nonsynonymous SNP PtoSAHHB_410 in an SAHH signature motif associated with fiber length (Q < 0.10).

entities.name: Populus tomentosa
observations: Chinese white poplar association and linkage populations were analyzed for SAHH-family allelic variation and wood traits.
PtoSAHH transcripts showed high abundance in developing and mature xylem.

entities.name: SAHH wood association
observations: LD-linkage analysis found PtoSAHHA_2203 and PtoSAHHB_1065, plus corresponding haplotypes, significantly associated with alpha-cellulose content.
PtoSAHHB_410, a nonsynonymous SNP in an SAHH signature motif, significantly associated with fiber length.
Across reported associations, the average phenotypic variance explained was 3.14%.
